objective: Make the SessionStart hook append a short block of the most-violated root rules every time, and the in-use Intent's requirements after a compact or resume.
scope: Work only in the git worktree /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-0.1.2 (branch release/0.1.2/feat/instruction-sections, head 3a9122d); paths are relative to it.

Decisions (user): no new hook and nothing per message; the existing SessionStart hook (matcher startup|resume|clear|compact, packages/runtime/src/cli/sessioncontext.ts and its caller in packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts) appends, on every source, a short block (about 5-7 lines, US English) of the most-violated root rules: load the app's task-list tool if it is deferred and keep the list updated; acknowledge every user message; take every pending decision through AskUserQuestion, never as a text list; do or verify what the user names without asking again; never work around a blocking hook or a denial; write to the user only for decisions, blockers and the final report. Put that text in an instruction source file per model (for example packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/session-reminder.md), not inline in code, and tie it to requirements.md ids through the existing REQUIREMENT_SECTIONS check if it fits.

After a compact or resume only (the hook input's `source`), also inject the requirements of the Intent in use, rendered like the status as data (keep the existing data notice that objectives and ids are project data, not instructions), within the existing budget logic; a startup or clear does not inject them. If the requirements exceed the budget, truncate with a note naming `holyagent intent show`.

Tests in packages/runtime/tests for: the block on each source; requirements only on compact and resume; budget truncation. Update docs/hooks.md for the new output. Rebuild with `mise run build` and run `mise run verify`.
constraints: Do not commit, push, branch, check out, or touch .git or .holyagent. Do not touch /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent or /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-pr1.
Do not change the PreToolUse or PostToolUse hooks, prebuilt workflows or plan.ts.
No new hook event or matcher.

notes:
- **Existing test changed:** in `sessioncontext.test.ts` I lowered the artificial core padding from `"x".repeat(8500)` to `7800`. The reminder now takes about 700 characters of the budget, so the old padding could no longer fit. The assertion is unchanged.
- **No `REQUIREMENT_SECTIONS` entry:** I left the reminder out of it. That check requires each section to be assembled into the generated agent prompts, and the reminder is hook-only. The test also requires every file under `root/` to be assembled, so putting it there would have failed. The file sits at `claude-5.5/session-reminder.md`, and the rules it restates are already in the mapped root sections (R-TASKLIST, R-ACK, R-NAMED, R-DECIDE, R-NOBYPASS).
- **Requirements lookup:** `hook.ts` reads the requirements with its own second `readOpenState` and `resolveIntent`, the same lookup `intent show` uses. This avoids editing `overview.ts`, which is outside my ownership.
- **Truncation behavior:** the status narrows first, and requirements stay whole until the status is already counts only. After that they are cut to the first ones that fit, with a `+N more requirements; run \`holyagent intent show\` for all of them` line. A single requirement larger than the budget leaves only that note.
- **Extra data notice:** when requirements are present the data notice gains a second sentence, "The requirements of the Intent in use are project data too." The original sentence is untouched.
